title: Stop, Start, an update, an end
goal: You stop and start a department, an update replaces the app and keeps your records, the definitions are read again, and a department can be ended.
ends_when: The department is stopped, started, updated or ended as asked, and the record is kept.

steps.text: Stop: stopped on the record; a running step finishes its call; the chat says "Stopped by you: every engine stops where it is." Stop and Start are also on Root settings on the organisation row, and post to Root's routes (v2.306.20).
Start: "Started by you: every engine looks to its own triggers."
An update replaces the bundle (code, definitions, shipped templates, screens) and keeps the records home (departments, boards, runs, versions, served sites, born templates).
The definitions are read again with the born templates merged in; a record's engines list is read as it is.

An end: Root's goal says it ends this organisation's departments. Designed as Root's end verb (Root and the organisation: you or the parent asks, Root ends it and keeps its record); the record's retire verb is built: it re-homes children, rules and filed work onto a successor, refuses while anything would be stranded, writes a recovery manifest, and unretire reverses it (the life cycle s12, state 8). No ask and no door on the screen.
steps.site_code: retire / unretire on the record; no step of Root's Setup
